name: kalai — brand-grade launch masters
description: A regression set of PAST Sundara Coffee Co. launch briefs, run through the full kalai studio (Creative Director -> Parallel(Designer, Copy) -> Brand-Fidelity loop -> fail-closed Compliance gate). Each case's reference describes the on-brand, compliance-cleared multi-platform master the studio should hand to kural. Cases are graded on two rubric tracks: brand fidelity and compliance clearance, both @ 0.80 (the LLM-judge threshold, distinct from the in-loop FIDELITY_THRESHOLD of 8.5). Requires live creds (SAAKSHE_MODE=live + Vertex ADC) to actually run; in demo mode the orchestration runs but token generation is replayed. The hero case is the Pro -> $34 pricing launch.

parts.text: Launch announcement for the decision: Raise Pro to $34 (not $39), grandfather all existing subscribers, give 30-day notice.

Master (compliance cleared, brand-fidelity 9.1): a calm, candid, anti-hype launch master across x, ig, and linkedin. Concept: 'clearer pricing, same obsession' - Pro moves to $34, early believers grandfathered, 30 days' notice. x: 'Pro is moving to $34 - and if you're already with us, you keep your price. 30 days' notice, no surprises.' ig: 'Same coffee obsession, clearer pricing. Pro -> $34. Early believers grandfathered.' linkedin: 'We're adjusting Pro to $34. Existing subscribers are grandfathered; everyone gets 30 days' notice. Here's the why ->'. The master honours the grandfathering trust promise in the brand canon, uses only claims the brief authorised, and was explicitly cleared by the fail-closed compliance gate before handoff to kural. kalai holds no channel keys and does not publish.

rubric_content.text_property: The master is on the brand canon (calm, candid, anti-hype voice; honours the grandfathering trust promise) rather than generic hype creative, and reads as something that would pass the studio's Brand-Fidelity bar.

rubrics.description: Brand-fidelity track. A studio rejects a launch master that drifts off the company's own brand canon.

rubric_content.text_property: The master makes only claims the brief authorised (the $34 price, grandfathering, 30-day notice), carries no deceptive or unsubstantiated superiority claims, and is something the fail-closed compliance gate would explicitly clear and hand to kural.

rubrics.description: Compliance track. A fail-closed gate must explicitly clear the master; unauthorised or unprovable claims must be blocked, not shipped.
